ideas.pitch: A supply chain tracking tag combining conductive ink analog signatures, ESP32 scanners, and Vertex AI to detect tampering and environmental spoilage in agricultural transit.
ideas.title: AgriTrace-ESP: Hardware-Secured Produce Logistics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the Agriculture and Smart Farming category while replicating the hardware-secured logistics approach that won 1st prize at Hack-4-Viksit Bharat.

ideas.pitch: An edge computer-vision system running on local hardware to instantly flag PPE compliance failures and machinery hazards on manufacturing floors without cloud latency.
ideas.title: EdgeGuard AI: Industrial Safety Violation Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Robotics and Automation / IoT domain by demonstrating a practical edge-AI deployment that easily sweeps industrial-focused tracks.

ideas.pitch: A closed-loop operations platform powered by Gemini and LangGraph that ingests time-series sensor data from municipal microgrids to autonomously diagnose and mitigate anomalies.
ideas.title: EcoGrid-Ops: Autonomous Multi-Agent Smart City Diagnostics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Smart City Solutions category and incorporates the multi-agent diagnostic pattern that secured 3rd prize at SEAL Hackathon 2026.

ideas.pitch: An assistive medical record summarizer and triage assistant running completely offline on NPUs to protect patient privacy in rural or disconnected healthcare settings.
ideas.title: MedAssist-NPU: Offline Clinical Decision Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with Healthcare and Assistive Technology while using the offline hardware-acceleration pattern that earned 2nd place at the Qualcomm Snapdragon Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered environmental accounting platform that cross-references corporate procurement graphs with real-time emissions data to flag greenwashing and audit anomalies.
ideas.title: CarbonLedger AI: Scope 3 Supply Chain Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Environmental and Social Innovation track and adopts the graph intelligence plus explainable ML architecture that won the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon.
